Class Tower

java.lang.Object
be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.game.entities.Entity
be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.game.entities.Tower
Direct Known Subclasses:
ArrowTower, CannonTower, IceTower
public abstract class Tower extends Entity
Abstract base class for all tower types.

Towers are stationary defensive structures placed on designated build spots. Each frame the game loop:

  1. Calls update(double) — decrements the fire cooldown.
  2. Calls findTarget(List) — returns the best enemy in range.
  3. If a target is found and the tower is ready to fire: fire(EntityFactory, Enemy) (the tower creates its projectile), then resetCooldown() (starts the inter-shot timer).
  4. Calls applyAreaEffect(List) — used by IceTower to apply its slow aura.

Each tower creates its own projectile via fire(EntityFactory, Enemy): an ArrowTower asks the factory for a ray projectile, a CannonTower for a cannon projectile. This keeps the game loop free of any type-checking (no instanceof) — the right projectile is chosen polymorphically. The tower depends only on the abstract EntityFactory, so the game/visualization separation is preserved.

Subclasses define the targeting strategy in findTarget(List):

  • ArrowTower — closest enemy in range (Streams: min by distance)
  • CannonTower — highest HP enemy in range (Streams: max by currentHealth)
  • IceTower — fastest enemy in range (Streams: max by speed)

    • Tower

      public Tower(Position position, double width, double height, double range, int damage, double fireRate, int cost)
      Shared constructor — all tower subclasses pass their stats up through super(...). fireCooldown starts at 0 so the tower can fire immediately when placed.
      Parameters:
      position - the build position in game-world coordinates
      width - the tower width in game-world units
      height - the tower height in game-world units
      range - the detection/attack radius in game-world units
      damage - the damage dealt per projectile hit
      fireRate - the number of shots per second
      cost - the gold cost to place this tower

  • Method Details

    • update

      public void update(double deltaTime)
      Decrements the fire cooldown by the elapsed frame time.

      Subclasses may override to add extra per-frame behaviour (e.g. IceTower applies its slow in applyAreaEffect(List) instead of here), but should still call super.update(deltaTime) to keep the cooldown ticking.

      Specified by:
      update in class Entity
      Parameters:
      deltaTime - the elapsed time since the previous frame, in seconds

    • findTarget

      public abstract Optional<Enemy> findTarget(List<Enemy> enemies)
      Selects the best target from the given list using this tower's strategy.

      Implementations must:

      • only consider enemies that are alive,
      • only consider enemies within range,
      • return Optional.empty() when no valid target exists (never null).

      The Java Streams API is used here (project requirement): filter by range, then apply a comparator to pick the best candidate.

      Parameters:
      enemies - the current list of enemies to choose from
      Returns:
      the selected target, or Optional.empty() if none is in range

    • fire

      public abstract Projectile fire(EntityFactory factory, Enemy target)
      Creates and returns the projectile this tower fires at the given target, using the abstract EntityFactory.

      Called by the game loop only when the tower has a target and its cooldown is ready. Each subclass picks the right factory method polymorphically:

      • ArrowTower → factory.createRayProjectile(...)
      • CannonTower → factory.createCannonProjectile(...)
      • IceTower → never fires (see IceTower).
      Parameters:
      factory - the abstract factory used to create the projectile
      target - the enemy this tower is firing at
      Returns:
      the newly created projectile

    • applyAreaEffect

      public void applyAreaEffect(List<Enemy> enemies)
      Applies a per-frame area effect to nearby enemies.

      The default implementation is a no-op. IceTower overrides this to apply a slow to all enemies within its range every frame. The game loop calls this on every tower every frame, so keep it cheap.

      Parameters:
      enemies - the current list of enemies that may be affected

    • resetCooldown

      public void resetCooldown()
      Resets the inter-shot cooldown.

      Call this immediately after the game loop has created a projectile for this tower, so it will not fire again until 1/fireRate seconds have passed.
